spec.description:
Bradford Optimo is a rigid, high-density glasswool insulation
batt specifically engineered for suspended timber floors in new builds and
retrofits. Sized deliberately narrower than wall batts (415mm and 565mm) to fit
snugly between floor joists, Optimo reduces subfloor heat loss by up to 20%,
blocks draughts, and dampens footstep resonance and external noise transmission
by up to 6dB. Non-combustible, low-allergen, and Sensitive Choice certified, it
is secured from below or above using proprietary Optimo Saddles, Straps, or
StayFast brackets and backed by a 70-year warranty.
features:
Specifically designed for suspended timber floors to eliminate cold floors and
subfloor draughts

Sized narrower (415mm and 565mm) for a tight, friction-fit
grip between timber joists

Rigid, high-density glasswool construction
prevents sagging and holds thickness

Cuts heat loss through suspended timber
floors by up to 20%

Reduces acoustic reverberation and foot traffic noise
through floorboards by up to 6dB

Non-combustible when tested in accordance
with AS 1530.1

National Asthma Council Sensitive Choice approved for
low-allergen indoor air quality

Simple installation using proprietary Optimo
Saddles (new builds), Straps, or StayFast brackets (retrofits)

Manufactured
from up to 80% recycled glass with bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation

Backed by
CSR Bradford's 70-year product performance warranty

technical.value:
1160 mm length x 415 mm width (for 450mm joists) or 565
mm width (for 600mm joists)

Reduces sound transmission through timber floors by up to 6 dB

install:
Turn off
power at main switchboard before entering subfloor space

Measure joist
spacings (use 415mm batts for 450mm centres; 565mm batts for 600mm centres)

In new builds, fit Optimo Saddles across joists at max 500mm spacing before
laying flooring, then place batts on saddle feet from above

For retrofit
beneath existing floors, push batts up tightly against underside of floorboards
ensuring no air gaps

Secure retrofitted batts using Optimo Straps fixed to
joists at max 500mm intervals and swivelled 90 degrees to support batts

Alternatively, use self-adhesive Optimo StayFast brackets (2 per side per batt)
fixed 300mm in from batt ends

Trim batts 5mm wider than opening if joist
spacing is irregular to maintain a snug friction fit

Take care not to block
subfloor ventilation openings
selection_checklist:
Measure joist
centres (450mm vs 600mm) to select 415mm or 565mm batt width

Confirm required
R-value (R2.1 or R2.5) based on climate zone and energy rating targets

Check
installation method (new build from above vs retrofit from subfloor
crawlspace)

Order corresponding fixing accessories (Optimo Saddles, Optimo
Straps, or Optimo StayFast brackets)

Ensure minimum crawl space clearance
exists for safe access in retrofit jobs
limitations:
Must be mechanically supported with Saddles, Straps, or
StayFast brackets to prevent gravity sagging over time

Do not cover
electrical subfloor wiring that may be susceptible to derating without checking
AS/NZS 3000

Do not block subfloor wall vents which are critical for moisture
dissipation

use_cases:
Retrofitting underfloor insulation beneath
existing polished timber floorboards in older homes to eliminate winter chills
and draughts

Installing between joists from above in new suspended timber
floor construction using Optimo Saddles

Dampening footstep noise and floor
hollow resonance in double-storey homes
not_for: Wall cavity framing batts (use Bradford Gold Wall)
